LiHua recognized that since Yuriko loved playing the bass and Wolfgang had a background in playing the drums, having all three of them together could enhance the musical experience and create a collaborative atmosphere. The jam session was open for anyone who was interested in music and willing to participate, with Yuriko expressing her enthusiasm and readiness to join in for the fun and creativity that the group could generate.
